sanskrit_verse:
पञ्च रूपाणि राजानो धारयन्त्यमितौजसः।
अग्नेरिन्द्रस्य सोमस्य यमस्य धनदस्य च॥
transliteration: pañca rūpāṇi rājāno dhārayanty amitaujasaḥ | agner indrasya somasya yamasya dhanadasya ca ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Kings bear five forms of sovereignty derived from the limitless radiance of divine authority: those of Fire, Indra, Soma, Yama, and Kubera.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority as a multidimensional expression of cosmic order
Causation through alignment with elemental and celestial forces
Capacity-based responsibility rooted in sovereign embodiment
Restoration logic via reconnection to source energies
Consciousness alignment through recognition of divine kingship
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler lacks resonance with any of the five sovereign forms THEN legitimacy deficit is declared AND restoration protocol initiates
IF judicial action disregards sovereign alignment THEN decision invalidity flag raised UNTIL realignment achieved
IF governance fails to reflect Agni's purification THEN corrective fire-yajna mandated at administrative level
IF economic policy ignores Dhanada's abundance principle THEN wealth redistribution enacted through consciousness-based fiscal reset
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of royal or state authority must demonstrate functional harmony with all five cosmic forms. Absence of even one renders the exercise of power constitutionally defective and subject to immediate rectification without punitive recourse.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya operates through pramāṇa that establishes sequential manifestation of sovereign capacity. Each form represents an ascending stage of conscious rulership. Failure at any stage invokes automatic completion process rather than punitive consequence. The law aligns with anupūrvaśaḥ by ensuring proportional responsibility flows from inherent capacity, not imposed obligation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign resonance assessment across five domains
Activate ritual and administrative pathways to restore missing sovereign form
Engage royal consciousness reintegration through Vedic consecration
Deploy fiscal and spiritual instruments to realign with Dhanada’s abundance matrix
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Kingship derives from the fivefold divine, Dharma is restored through sovereign alignment, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
